title: SEAL: SAFETY-ENHANCED ALIGNED LLM FINE-TUNING VIA BILEVEL DATA SELECTION
reasoning: The paper focuses on safety-enhanced alignment for LLMs, specifically addressing the challenge of preventing models from generating harmful or unsafe content after fine-tuning. It evaluates its method using safety-oriented benchmarks like Anthropic Helpful and Harmless (HH) and HEX-PHI, which are designed to measure a model's alignment with human ethical standards and safety constraints.
